title: Line Extensions and New Service Construction — Design Changes, Cancellation and Temporary Service Conversion
content:
The provisions below apply to **Line Extensions and New Service Construction** projects with Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative once an application is on file.

### Design changes after the estimate

A design change requested by the member after the estimate is billed the change order fee; when it changes the estimate by more than the class's revision threshold percent, a new estimate with a new validity period is issued instead. A change order records the revised overhead feet, the revised underground feet, the revised estimate and the revised contribution on the project.

| Change in the estimate from the member's design change (hypothetical, 10 percent threshold) | More than the threshold | Result |
|---|---|---|
| $15,000.00 to $16,200.00 (8 percent) | No | Change order fee billed; footage, estimate and contribution revised |
| $15,000.00 to $16,500.00 (exactly 10 percent) | No | Change order fee billed; footage, estimate and contribution revised |
| $15,000.00 to $17,250.00 (15 percent) | Yes | A new estimate with a new validity period is issued instead |

### Cancellation

A member may cancel at any time before construction starts: in applied, engineering, estimate issued or contract signed status, or in scheduled status before construction has started. On cancellation the project moves to cancelled status and the date is recorded. Where the class keeps the engineering design fee on cancellation, the design fee is kept; costs already incurred are kept, the unpaid rest of the contribution is written off, and payments beyond costs incurred are refunded within the class's cancellation refund period in calendar days.

**Illustration (hypothetical, 30-day refund period).** A member cancels a project in contract signed status. The contribution billed is $10,000.00, the member has paid $4,000.00 toward it, and costs already incurred on the project are $1,500.00. The $1,500.00 of costs incurred is kept; the unpaid rest of the contribution, $10,000.00 less $4,000.00, that is $6,000.00, is written off; and the payments beyond costs incurred, $4,000.00 less $1,500.00, that is $2,500.00, are refunded within 30 calendar days. Where the class keeps the design fee, the design fee is kept as well.

### Temporary Construction Service

A temporary service is disconnected after the class's connection limit in months, and the temporary conversion credit is credited when it is converted to a permanent extension at the same site.
